title: Misnamed scripts, batch 1: five renamed to their class name by script, every caller relinked

chat.text: The scripts census found 26 scripts that break your naming rule (a class in a lowercase file, or a bag of functions). The five with the fewest callers are renamed by a reusable script with a manifest, every caller rewritten, the old names kept as aliases for a week, undo proven on a copy first. The remaining 21 wait for the next batches.
